claims: The 2026 NCAA Men's Frozen Four will take place April 9 and 11, 2026.
The 2026 NCAA Men's Frozen Four will take place at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas, NV.
The 2026 NCAA Men's Frozen Four marks the first time the Division I men's ice hockey championship has been held in Las Vegas.
The 2026 NCAA Men's Frozen Four features the national semifinals on April 9.
The 2026 NCAA Men's Frozen Four features the championship game on April 11.
